newsitem.title: GHANA: Shares firm on Ghana bourse, volume drops.
newsitem.headline: Shares firm on Ghana bourse, volume drops.

text.p: Shares firmed on the Ghana Stock Exchange on Friday, with three equities gaining and none declining, although volume fell markedly.
The GSE All-Share Index jumped 2.89 points to 362.80.
Traders blamed a pre-Christmas lull for the sharp fall in turnover to 32,110 shares traded from 60,920 on Wednesday.

Shares bid stood at 149,700 against offers of 1.7 million shares, with Standard Chartered Bank the most actively traded. It climbed 200 cedis to 5,100 cedis. Guiness Ghana Ltd added 11 cedis to 275. Social Security Bank gained a cedi to 1,056.
